name: Cashew Biscuits
tagline: Rich in tradition, baked with love
description: Crisp, buttery biscuits studded with real cashew pieces. A tea-time classic made the traditional way.
ingredients: Refined wheat flour (maida), sugar, butter, vanaspati, milk solids, cashew, baking powder and a pinch of salt.
storage: Keep in an airtight container in a cool, dry place.
